_note: The live database connection, the Auth0 settings for this 'mcp' audience, and the stdio transport's trusted local principal are all read at runtime from ~/.jumptest.json by the common Config loader -- add an 'auth0' section (domain, audiences.mcp) and a servers.mcp section ({ principal, port }) there, not here. This file plays no part in that configuration; it exists only for parity with the .NET/api appsettings.json layout. Over --transport http the MCP server binds the first free port in 5300-5400 unless servers.mcp.port is set; --transport stdio (the default) ignores the port range entirely.
